question: A, B and C working separately can do a piece of work in 5, 8 and 6 days, respectively. If they all work together and earn ₹22,774 for the whole work, then find the difference between the shares of B and C.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM(5, 8, 6) = 120 units.

Efficiency ratio (A : B : C) = (120 ÷ 5) : (120 ÷ 8) : (120 ÷ 6) = 24 : 15 : 20.

Total efficiency = 24 + 15 + 20 = 59 units/day.

Wages are distributed in the ratio of their efficiencies as they work together.

Difference between shares of B and C = [(20 − 15) ÷ 59] × 22774 = 5 × 386 = 1930.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,930.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A = 5 days

Time taken by B = 8 days

Time taken by C = 6 days

Total wage earned by all together = ₹22,774

**Formula Used:**

Wage ratio = Ratio of efficiencies (Total work ÷ Time taken)

⇒ Total combined efficiency = 24 + 15 + 20 = 59

⇒ 59 parts = ₹22,774

⇒ 1 part = 22774 ÷ 59 = ₹386

⇒ Difference in efficiency parts of B and C = 20 − 15 = 5 parts

⇒ Difference in their shares = 5 × 386 = ₹1,930

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,930.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work and Wages

When individuals work together for the exact same duration, the total wages earned are divided strictly in proportion to their daily efficiencies or working capacities.

Different Duration of Work

If workers join or leave mid-way and thus work for a different number of days, their wage share is based directly on the actual amount of work completed by each (Efficiency × Days Worked).

Pipes and Cisterns

Similar to the Time & Work principle, an inlet pipe carries a positive efficiency while a leakage or outlet pipe represents a negative efficiency. The overall work done is calculated using their net algebraic sum.
